book.name: 1 Corinthians
book.title: 1 Corinthians Saint Paul, Corinth gwizhit Gwik'injiighit Nąįį Tr'ookit ts'ą' Ch'adąąntł'oo

content: Jii Kwaii Chan Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą Ts'an Jidii Vit'eegwahahchy'aa Geenjit Diinantł'eiinlii

Ch'eet'igwiniindhan akhwa'yaa geenjit gwint'aii gwitr'it t'agoh'in. Jidii Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą nakhwantł'inlii ąįį zhit gwandaa gwihil'ee t'akhwa'yaa geenjit nakhwadrii zhit gohłii. Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eegoohkhii ąįį ch'andaa t'akhwa'in.

Zhit juu Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą haa gwikyaa zhit ginkhii nąįį ch'izhii dinjii haa giginkhii t'iginyąą kwaa, ch'ihłee gaa duuyeh gooviitth'ak geh'an, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ts'ą' giginkhii t'iginyąą. Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą vat'aii k'iighai' ginjik vaagwiindaii kwaa zhit łi'didlii haa giginkhii t'iginyąą.
Zhit juu Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eeginkhii nąįį t'ee dinjii ts'iginyąą, ts'ą' khaneegoogaayu' gwizhit gooveeginyąą ts'ą' t'aih goots'an gahtsii.
Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą gwikyaa zhit ginkhii nąįį geedan zhrįh idits'iginyaa, gaa juu Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eeginkhii t'ee tr'igiinkhii zheh nineedal nąįį ts'iginyąą t'igii'in.

Datthak ts'ą' Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą gwikyaa zhit gohkhii nahoihnyąą, gaa datthak ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eegoohkhii ji' gwandaa gweheezyaa. Juu Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eeginkhii t'ee gwikyaa zhit girinkhii andaa gwihil'ee t'oonchy'aa. Gwikyaa zhit ginkhii ąįį deegwinyąą t'igwinyąą geegwaandak ji' gwizhrįh juu tr'igiinkhii zheh nineedal nąįį ts'igiheenjyaa.

Ąįįts'ą' shachaa nąįį nakhwats'ą' khoiizhii ts'ą' gwikyaa zhit gihkhii ts'ą' shootth'ak kwaa ji' nakhwats'ihihjyaa gwakwaa. Jidii Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa shats'ą' gwigweełkįį nakhwaagwahaldak ts'ą' gwizhįh shintł'eegwiin'ąįį, ąįį nakhwantł'eegwiilii ji' gwizhrįh nakhwats'ihihjyaa.
Jii gwik'it gooh'in, Flute akwat ch'iitsiidlii harp, haa ch'ilik tr'ahtsii ąįį gwandaii nilii kwaa t'inchy'aa. Gwinzii tr'iheetth'ak ky'aa vaach'ohłii kwaa ji' duuyeh jidii ach'oohłii gaagiindaii.
Ąįįts'ą' niveet'arah'in geenjit ch'ilik (bugle) gwinzii ach'aahłii kwaa ji', juu niveet'ahah'yaa geenjit gwats'ą' heekhaa?
Ąįį gwik'it gwikyaa zhit ginkhii gwinzii nigiitth'ak kwaa ji', nats'ąą deiinyąą t'iinyąą naagiheendaii? Zhyaa niginjik an heelyaa t'oonchy'aa.
Jii nankat łyaa ginjik nihłehjuk t'inchy'aa lęįį gwanlii, ts'ą' ginjik datthak chan juu yizhit ginkhii nąįį deenyąą t'inyąą gaagiindaii.
Gaa nijin ąįį ginjik deegwinyąą t'igwinyąą gaashandaii kwaa ji', zhit juu yat'ąąhchy'aa nąįį ch'adanh nahkat giinlii ts'ą' goovaashahandaii kwaa ts'ą' geedan chan shaagiheendaii kwaa t'iginchy'aa.
Łyaa Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą jidii nakhwantł'eegwinlii gęhdaa kwaa nohthan ji' vaa tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit t'aih goots'an hohtsyaa geenjit gwik'eegǫhdaii.
Juu tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit gwikyaa zhit ginkhii ji', deiinyąą t'inyąą gaagweheendaii geenjit khadigiheejyaa gwizhrįh goo'aii.
Nijin gwikyaa zhit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vats'a' khadigihjii dąį', Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą shizhit t'inchy'aa k'iighai' khagidihjii, gaa deihnyąą t'ihnyąą gaashandaii kwaa.
Geenjit deeshi'yaa? Geetee hee Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą, akwat shagwandaii haa khadigeheejyaa. Geetee hee shagwandaii akwat Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą haa ch'ilik eehihłyaa.
Nijin Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą zhit gwizhrįh Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vats'a' mahsį' diinyąą ji', juu vaa khagidiinjii nąįį deiinyąą t'iinyąą naagiindaii kwaa gwiizhit nats'ąą gwik'it gooli' giheenjyaa?
Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą zhit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa mahsį' vaiinyąą ąįį gwinzii t'iinyąą ji', gaa duuyeh ch'izhii nąįį ts'iinyąą t'oonchy'aa.
Nakhwandah gwikyaa zhit giihkhii geenjit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa mahsį' choh vaihnyąą.

Gaa tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit shireheetth'ak geenjit ginjik ch'ihłoanli' aanchy'aa haa giihkhii ts'ąįį gweheezyaa vaa geech'oohaałchyaa geenjit. Gwikyaa zhit ginjik (thousands) haa nakhwats'ą' giihkhii ji' gaa duuyeh deihnyąą t'ihnyąą gaakhwandaii ts'ą' nakhwats'inyąą.

Shachaa nąįį, tr'iinin nats'ahts'ą' ninjich'adhat k'it t'ohchy'aa kwaa, gaa tr'iinin tsal tr'agwaanduu gaandaii kwaa k'it t'ohchy'aa, ąįįts'ą' chan nakhwagwik'injigwiighit zhit ch'anjaa k'it ninjich'ǫhthat.
Dęhtły'aa Choh zhit gwadanakhwatł'oo,

content.text: “K'eegwaadhat jyaa nyąą, ch'adanh nahkat dinjii nąįį digiginjik zhit giginkhii k'it shigii nąįį ts'ą' gigiheehkhyaa.
Ąįį dinjii nąįį sheenjit giginkhii, ąįį googaa shigii nąįį shigiheetth'ak kwaa.”

content: Ąįį geh'an jii gaagwiindaii, Gwikyaa zhit girinkhii t'ee juu, gwik'injiighit kwaa nąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vat'aii gahah'yaa geenjit t'oonchy'aa ts'ą' gwik'injiighit nąįį ąįį nakwaa. Ąįįts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eeginkhii t'ee juu gwik'injiighit nąįį ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vat'aii gwizhrįh gwigweech'in goodlit ts'ą' juu gwik'injiighit kwaa nąįį eenjit t'inchy'aa kwaa.

Ąįįts'ą' nijin gwik'injiighit nąįį khaihłan łagaajil ts'ą' datthak gwikyaa zhit gohkhii gwiizhit, gwik'injiighit kwaa nąįį akwat gwik'injigwiighit gwinzii haandaii kwaa nąįį nihdeiinjil ji' datthak gwinzii nakhwaagoo'aii kwaa giheenjyaa.

Gaa datthak ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eegoohkhii gwizhit gwik'injiighit kwaa nąįį akwat gwik'injigwiighit gwinzii haandaii kwaa nąįį ch'ihłee nihdeiinzhii ji' gwinzii nakhwagiitth'ak geh'an gootr'agwaanduu gwanlii łee gwik'eegahaandal.

Jidii gweentak gininjich'agahthat kwaii gwizhrįh nigweheedaa, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ts'ą' nikiigwagahah'aa ts'ą' shatr'agwaanduu gwanlii giheenjyaa. “Łi'haa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa nakhwatee t'inchy'aa łee!” giheenjyaa.
Tr'igiinkhii Zheh Łineeriidal Dąį' Deegwehee'yaa Goo'aii

Shachaa nąįį jii jyaa dihnyąą t'ihnyąą; nijin tr'igiinkhii gohtsii geenjit khaihłan nineekhwadal dąį' nakhwatee ch'ihłee Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vich'ilik iilii, ts'ą' ch'izhii chan gwinzii geech'ǫąąhtan gwiizhit ch'izhii chan Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ts'an deeheenjyaa yats'ą' gwagwahkįį, ch'izhii chan gwikyaa zhit ginkhii, ts'ą' ch'ihłee chan ąįį deenyąą t'inyąą geegwaandak. Jii datthak t'ee tr'igiinkhii zheh nineedal nąįį ts'igiheenjyaa jyaa digihee'yaa goo'aii t'oonchy'aa.
Nakhwatee ch'ihłee gwikyaa zhit giheehkhyaa ji', neekwaii akwat tik ǫhłįį ts'ą' nihłehtąįį t'akhwa'in, gaa ch'ihłee deegwihnyąą t'igwinyąą geegwahaandak gwizhrįh goo'aii.
Gaa nakhwatee ch'ihłee deegwinyąą t'igwinyąą geegwahaandak zhat dhidii kwaa ji', deegohtsai' kwaa ts'ą' idizhit gwats'an gwikyaa zhit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vats'a' khagadǫhjii.
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik neekwaii akwat tik ǫhłįį haa nakhwateegwagwaanchy'aa ts'ą' veegohkhii ąįįtł'ęę nakhwatee ch'izhii nąįį dohnyąą gwik'iighai' łyaa t'igwinyąą ji' geegigiheekhyaa geenjit.
Geech'oohtan gwiizhit nakhwatee dinjii ch'ihłak Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik oonjik ji', ąįį dinjii giheehkhyaa geenjit zhit juu geech'ǫąąhtan ąįį akhagoonyąą.
Nakhwatee gwagwaanchy'aa ts'ą' gwik'it t'ohthan ji' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eegoohkhii. Gwik'iighai' juu nąįį datthak gwagwahaa'ee ts'ą' gook'injigwiighit gwandaa nint'aii heelyaa geenjit.
Dinjii, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eegiheekhyaa vantł'eegwirin'ąįį gaa nihk'it deeheenjyaa gwik'eehaahtyaa,
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vigii tr'iinlii ts'ą' tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit nihzheedarahaa'ee kwaa goo'aii, ts'ą' vizheh gwizhit tsinehdan tr'iheelyaa ts'ą' gwinzii nihłaa gwarahah'aa goo'aii.

Tr'igiinkhii zheh khaihłan nineedal nąįį tee tr'injaa nąįį gigiheehkhyaa kwaa goo'aii. Jewish goo-Law tee ąįį khaihłan nineegiidal dąį', tr'injaa nąįį zhat gwa'an gwats'ą' k'eedeegwagwahaadhat kwaa goo'aii gwinyąą.
K'eegwiichy'aa gaagoondaii giindhan ji' digizheh gwizhit gwa'an hee dagakai' goohaahkat goo'aii. Tr'injaa, tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit gigiheehkhyaa geenjit oozhii gwaahchy'aa t'oonchy'aa.
Akwat nakhwats'an Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik tr'aatth'ak lee t'oonchy'aa? Nakhwan zhrįh nakhwats'ą' tr'aatth'ak lee t'inchy'aa?

Nakhwatee ch'ihłee Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Eenjit Ginkhii nilii akwat Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą vigwitr'it gwinzii vantł'eegwatth'ak nindhan ji' t'ee gaaheendaii geenjit, jii nakhwats'ą' ch'adįhtł'oo t'ee K'eegwaadhat gwats'ą' shah'ee t'ishi'in.
Gaa jii deihnyąą datthak gweechyaa kwaa ji' nakhwan t'ee dohchyaa shrǫ'.
Shachaa nąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik nakhwadrii zhit gwats'an veegwarookhyaa ohnyąą, gaa gwikyaa zhit gigiheehkhyaa gwits'į' t'agavoiinyą' shrǫ'!
Tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit deekhwa'in datthak gwinzii t'akhwa'in nihghootee hee gohkhyaa shrǫ' gaa ch'ihłak zhrįh ǫhłįį ts'ą' goohkhii.
